name: sarama-deterministic-consumer-group-a1a8
instr:
Sarama cannot capture deterministic consumer-group rebalance histories or replay them locally through MockBroker. Add portable transcripts for negotiation, assignment, sessions, offsets, and terminal outcomes, without changing unused behavior.

Give each cycle stable identities for the cycle, ordered phases, coordinator, member, generation, protocol, requested topics, and retries, plus exactly one ending, including cancellation at any RebalancePhase. Preserve production identities and assignment meaning in mock responses. Make assignments canonical, generation-bound, atomic to decode, consistent with BalanceStrategyPlan, and reject duplicate or unavailable ownership.

Bind setup, claims, cleanup, release, marks, and commits to the session generation and assignment. Setup precedes claims; cleanup follows claim completion; no claim event follows the terminal boundary. Observation must not alter offsets. Distinguish setup, ConsumeClaim, cleanup, and cancellation outcomes, including cleanup failure after claim completion. Preserve error delivery, Consume ordering, offsets, constructors, MockSequence exhaustion, and broker correlation.

Replay advances only for the expected request and group. Match SyncGroup request assignments to the recorded member ownership, handler boundaries, and committed offsets. On divergence, preserve position and identify expected and actual identity or phase, or topic, partition, and expected and actual offset. Fingerprint user data and offset metadata
